User input persisted exactly once: record_user_message after durable record_run_started, only RunOrigin::User; failure yields honest Failed terminal (runs.rs:1347-1381); CurrentSubmission appended once, branch_run_inputs dedupe on load (model_history.rs:186-189)

Effective branch only: list_branch_messages follows branch_id_chain root->head (adapters session_tree.rs:889-935); fork boundary truncation + lineage owner/agent validation (model_history.rs:160-205); branch-head-change refusals on record (model_history.rs:795-875)

Protocol fidelity: validate_pairs enforces complete tool request/result pairing (model_history.rs:1210-1217); F08 projected_tool_item never reads raw cards as model input (model_history.rs:1220+); opaque blocks require origin verified against model_call_usage incl. protocol match (model_history.rs:536-565); host/tool identity bound to source Run prefixes (model_history.rs:572-582)

Cross-provider opaque: TurnOrigin::authorizes requires exact provider+model (kernel model_exchange.rs:287-306); enforced at anthropic_messages.rs:278, google_generative_ai.rs:254, openai_responses.rs:239; no-origin same-family opaque renders as plain user message, never silently forwarded

findings.title: fork/retry/rewind 与正常执行缺乏统一会话操作互斥
evidence: Unified admission: kernel SessionAdmission single gate shared by fork/retry/rewind (service session_tree.rs begin at 499), checkpoints (:1107,:1279), execute (runs.rs:1158-1241 same-gate try_acquire or retain_authorized_run_permit with session_admission_changed_or_unconfirmed recheck), archive/delete/create (session_admin.rs:218)

Per canonical SQLite path sharing via weak registry, independent homes do not block each other (adapters run_store.rs:141-160,192); admission mutex held only at register/release, never across network waits; multi-SID sorted single atomic acquire, no partial holds (session_admission.rs:20-42)

Ownership filtered before busy disclosure; state re-read and can_access rechecked after permit acquisition (session_tree.rs:500-520); operation task owns the lease through receipt persistence (session_tree.rs:560)

TOCTOU: in-transaction fork depth recheck + session_operations::verify expected version (adapters session_tree.rs:658-663); branch head revision increments; lifecycle/permission reloaded via load_session_admission (run_store.rs:1551-1565); requestId idempotency/conflict via session_operations journal (Begin::Fresh vs replay)

State+event recoverable consistency: v10 session_operations table (migrations.rs:568-584); fork row + insert_key_event + complete receipt in one write transaction (adapters session_tree.rs:695-877); no task recreation to backfill events

Independent re-run: r06_ar_f03_operations 21/21 incl. authenticated_barrier_rewind_execute_and_cancelled_waiter, positive_and_fork_event_atomicity, unknown_file_effect_survives_storage_failure_restart_and_replay, latest_permission_and_lifecycle_are_rechecked_before_commit, slow_model_does_not_block_independent_session_or_metadata, same_database_constructor_and_instance_contract, native/resourceio cancel-retains-admission family

findings.title: SessionFile 的活动、分支继承与引用登记仍未接通生产链
evidence: Real activity writes: touch_on_connection inside record_run_started transaction (adapters run_store.rs:1628); time regression guarded by MAX(COALESCE(last_activity,0),now) (session_files.rs:1413-1420); coldness reads sessions.last_activity_unix_ms consistently (session_files.rs:957-997)

Formal fork inheritance: in-transaction reference_identities of retained messages -> fork_files_on_connection copies managed payloads, mints target-owner-derived ids, accumulates legacy id/path aliases (adapters session_tree.rs:654-725); alias resolution scoped to owning session only, no global alias exposure (sessionfiles.rs:1347-1374); collision names uniquified per incumbent uniqueManagedForkName semantics

Reference closure: sync_message_refs in same transaction on tool_call_completed results (run_store.rs:1107-1122) and final message writes (:1871) plus rewind/reset paths (adapters session_tree.rs:264,385,851); collect_reference_identities names broken identities instead of silently dropping

Cleanup on real facts: cleanup_cold_payloads deletes only managed_cache non-expired payloads, protects all live refs/active runs/physical readers via payload leases, guards canonical managed roots, refuses external files even inside cache dir; owned-cache identity removed only after successful sweep

NoopChangeLog no longer in formal wiring: composition root injects filehistory::FileProductChangeLog::new(file_history, session_files) into register_core_file_tools (service lib.rs:1330-1341); NoopChangeLog remains a legacy/test-only type (filetools.rs:387)

Independent re-run: r06_ar_f04_lifecycle 15/15 via real HTTP service incl. f04_c01_formal_fork_retains_attachment_in_siblings, f04_c02_real_activity_cleanup_and_clock_rollback (real positive deletion), f04_c03_reference_commit_cleanup_window_is_atomic, f04_c04_legacy_import_interrupt_missing_and_restart, permanent-delete/lease/expired-blob recovery cases
